exposure: Gestational weight gain according to Institute of Medicine (IOM) guidelines (<12.7kg, 12.7-18.1kg, >18.1kg)
Gestational weight gain according to Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW) guidelines (<9kg, 9-12kg, >12kg)
finding: Gestational weight gain of >12kg (MHLW guidelines) or 12.7-18.1kg (IOM guidelines) was associated with best outcomes.
